topic: What feed element spacing balance minimizes dB loss while maintaining beamforming flexibility in defocused systems?
consensus_response: Optimal feed element spacing balances mutual coupling and array resolution. Advanced materials reduce mutual coupling, allowing closer spacing without increased dB loss. Metamaterials enhance directivity for wider spacing, preserving angular resolution and beamforming flexibility.
reference_context: Defocused reflector antennas with digital beamforming offer robustness against feed failures, minimizing gain loss.
